title: 第2129章 仙器凋魂镖第2128章 穆俪所谋
slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：凡人修仙，谁能比我极阴更阴！第二卷：玄界第2129章仙器凋魂镖（..la）眼下闲来无事，宋文索性逐一尝试、那些成仙之后，尚未动用的秘法。
首先是几门瞳术，他全都逐一试了试；倒是全都能正常使用。
宝光灵目和梦浮真瞳?这两门功能性瞳术，威能有着显著的提升，令他能看到地下更深处或是天地元气更为细微的变化。
但破法神目这部攻伐秘术，威力提升却是有限，只怕难堪大用。
接着，宋文又试了炼化过的几种煞气，威能皆不尽如人意。反倒是他体内的尸气，随着修为提升，越发浓烈霸道。
“看来，以后还得多收罗一些手段和仙器。”宋文心中暗忖。
他如今能拿得出手的手段，也只有从骨九幽手中夺取的那柄仙器骨剑、血海帝印，以及‘九大天雷秘法’和‘寂灭阳雷’。
除此之外，就只有玄天灵宝的九厄量天剑和几口极品灵器，但威能都略显不足。
至于血海帝印，也急需找齐材料，重新祭炼。否则，威能依旧难以比肩仙器，更配不上本命法宝之名。
转眼，时间过去数个时辰。
日头西落，月明星稀。
穆俪终于姗姗而至。
她径直飞至栖云泽上空，神识四下探寻。
这时，宋文自远处黑漆漆的山影间而出，飞身到了穆俪身侧。
“勾钧道友，阁下倒是谨慎。”穆俪意有所指的说道。
显然，她是在暗指，宋文防着她。
“在下出身散修，习惯谨慎行事，还望穆道友勿怪。”宋文话锋一转，扯开话题道，“穆道友，你确定纪桐会途经于此？”
穆俪道，“此地距离炎阳金矿不过二三十万里，纪桐若前往炎阳金矿，只要不是提前听到风声，必然不会选择绕道远行。”
二人随后降下身形，落于湖底，由穆俪布下一座隐匿阵法，隐藏两人身形。
宋文看着四周暗青色的屏障，心头顿时有所意动。

此阵，应是一座仙阶阵法。
宋文虽先后得到了骨九幽、羽秋、盖庐的储物戒，但这三人身上，竟然没有一座仙阶隐匿阵法。
只在骨九幽的储物戒中，找到了一座杀阵，名为《白骨修罗阵》。
转念之间，宋文又想到了，当初在那场交流会上，穆俪拿出的万里移形符和太一真水。
如此看来，穆俪虽身处这濒临源炁死域的荒凉之地，但好东西倒是不少，也不知从何而来。
宋文压下心中所想，于阵法的一角，打坐静修。
而穆俪，也同样打坐调息。
......
时间缓缓流逝，转眼半月过去。
这日。
湖泊上空，忽有一艘飞船自西方而来，迅疾朝着炎阳金矿的方向驶去。
穆俪脸色一凛，蓦然起身。
“若我没有看错，此船乃纪桐所有。”
“那此刻便动手？”宋文身上气势凌厉。
穆俪摇了摇头。
“不急，等他归来。还能多得一批炎阳金。”
话落，飞船已经从湖泊上空掠过，逐渐远去。
穆俪并没有再次打坐，而是唤出了一枚飞镖。
此镖，形若柳叶，长约三寸，两头尖细，中间略宽，线条流畅而纤薄，通体幽黑，却泛着冷冽寒芒，宛如一枚刚从枝头飘落的柳叶被凝固成了精铁。
“此镖名为‘凋魂’，乃下品仙器。取黄泉寒铁为胎，融万年冥晶为刃，经阴火淬炼千年年方成，最适于偷袭。”

穆俪竟然主动开口为宋文介绍那柳叶镖。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Among mortals cultivating immortality, who can be more yin than me! Volume 2: Mysterious World Chapter 2129 Immortal Weapon Withering Soul Dart (..la) Now that he has nothing to do, Song Wen simply tries one by one the secret techniques that he has not yet used after becoming an immortal.
First, there were several pupil techniques, and he tried them all one by one; however, they all worked normally.
Baoguang Lingmu and Mengfu Zhenpu? The power of these two functional pupil techniques has been significantly improved, allowing him to see deeper underground or more subtle changes in the vitality of heaven and earth.
However, the power of the secret attack technique of Breaking the Divine Eyes is limited, so I'm afraid it will be embarrassing and useless.
Then, Song Wen tried several refined evil spirits, but the power was not satisfactory. On the contrary, the corpse energy in his body became stronger and more domineering as his cultivation level improved.
"It seems that we need to collect more methods and magical weapons in the future." Song Wen thought to himself.
The only means he can use now are the immortal bone sword, the Blood Sea Emperor Seal, the 'Nine Heavenly Thunder Secret Technique' and the 'Nirvana Yang Thunder' that he seized from Gu Jiuyou.
Apart from this, there are only Xuantian Lingbao's Nine Era Calm Heaven Sword and a few top-grade spiritual weapons, but their power is slightly insufficient.
As for the Blood Sea Imperial Seal, there is an urgent need to find the materials and refining it. Otherwise, the power will still be difficult to compare with that of an immortal weapon, and it will not be worthy of the name of a natal magic weapon.
In the blink of an eye, several hours passed.
The sun sets in the west and the moon and stars are sparse.
Mu Li finally arrived.
She flew straight to the sky above Qiyunze, searching around with her consciousness.
At this time, Song Wen emerged from the dark mountain shadows in the distance and flew to Mu Li's side.
"Fellow Daoist Gou Jun, you must be cautious," Mu Li said pointedly.
Obviously, she was implying that Song Wen was on guard against her.
"I am a loose cultivator and am used to acting cautiously. I hope Fellow Daoist Mu will not be surprised." Song Wen changed the topic and said, "Friend Daoist Mu, are you sure Ji Tong will pass through here?"
Mu Li said, "This place is only two to three hundred thousand miles away from the Yanyang Gold Mine. If Ji Tong goes to the Yanyang Gold Mine, he will definitely not choose to take a long detour unless he hears about it in advance."
The two then lowered their bodies and landed on the bottom of the lake. Mu Li set up a concealment formation to hide their figures.
Song Wen looked at the dark blue barriers around him, and his heart suddenly moved.
This formation should be an immortal-level formation.
Although Song Wen had successively obtained the storage rings of Gu Jiuyou, Yu Qiu, and Gai Lu, these three people did not have an immortal-level concealment formation.
Only in Gu Jiuyou's storage ring was a killing formation named "White Bone Shura Formation".
In a flash of thought, Song Wen thought again of the Thousand Miles of Shapeshifting Talisman and Taiyi True Water that Mu Li took out at that exchange meeting.
From this point of view, although Mu Li is in this desolate place on the verge of Yuanqi's death zone, there are a lot of good things, and she doesn't know where they come from.
Song Wen suppressed his thoughts and meditated in a corner of the formation.
Mu Li also meditated and adjusted her breath.
...
Time passed slowly, and half a month passed in the blink of an eye.
This day.
Above the lake, a spaceship suddenly came from the west and headed quickly towards the Yanyang Gold Mine.
Mu Li's face turned stern and she stood up suddenly.
"If I'm not mistaken, this ship belongs to Ji Tong."
"Then take action now?" Song Wen's aura was fierce.
Mu Li shook her head.
"Don't worry, wait for him to come back. You can still get a lot of Yanyang Gold."
By the time he finished speaking, the spaceship had passed over the lake and gradually moved away.
Mu Li did not meditate again, but called out a dart.
This dart is shaped like a willow leaf, about three inches long, with two pointed ends and a slightly wider middle. The lines are smooth and thin. The whole body is dark, but with a cold and cold light, just like a willow leaf that has just fallen from the branch and has been solidified into fine iron.
"This dart is called 'Withered Soul', and it is a low-grade immortal weapon. It is made from the cold iron of the underworld, melted into ten thousand years of underworld crystals as its blade, and tempered by Yin fire for thousands of years before it is completed. It is most suitable for sneak attacks."
Mu Li actually took the initiative to speak forSong Wen introduced the willow leaf escort.
